summary: Virax Biolabs Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release about its wholly owned subsidiary entering an exclusive multi-country commercial supply agreement with Fosun Diagnostics for the ImmuneSelect research-use immune profiling product line. The agreement covers six Southeast Asian markets and is a routine commercial distribution deal, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situations event is involved. The filing is a standard announcement for a commercial supply arrangement, thus it does not qualify as a special situation requiring categorization.
